title: samir-rao-people-ops-manager-prep-q2-2026
content:
Purpose: quick notes for 1:1 + manager prep. Combine self-review bullets, progress on OKRs, blockers, and ask list. Draft - will clean up before handing to manager.

Context:
- Role: Senior People Ops Partner (supporting Eng + Product)
- Time at Redwood: 2.5 years
- Focus areas this cycle: hiring velocity for serving-runtime and infra, onboarding revamp, manager enablement program, compensation calibration support.

Self-review highlights (concise):
- Hiring & ramp: Led hiring blitz for serving-runtime (SWE IC + MLE) - closed 6 offers in Q1 (target 5). Reduced average time-to-offer from 39 days -> 28 days by updating interview rubric + coordinated panel scheduling.
- Onboarding revamp: Launched new 30/60/90 checklist and buddy program pilot with infra team; 4 hires reported improved clarity in first week (N=7 pilot). Draft playbook in Confluence (CONFLUENCE-OPS-4532).
- Manager enablement: Ran two enablement sessions for first-time managers (12 attendees) - follow-up resources created. Observed need for clearer calibration guide (action: work with People Science to produce 1-pager).
- Compensation & calibration: Supported calibration cycle prep; built summary sheets for Eng managers (template JIRA-HIRE-1124). Flag: still waiting on comp bands doc from Finance (FM-comp-bands v2).
- Cross-functional impact: Partnered with Recruiting to adjust sourcing mix (more contractor -> perm conversion focus), contributed to SRE on-call hiring prioritization which reduced backlog of hiring blockers by 30%.

Metrics / measurable outcomes (Q1 -> current):
- Time-to-offer: 39d -> 28d (target <=30d)
- Offer acceptance rate: 78% -> 81%
- New hire satisfaction (first-week survey, pilot): 3.2 -> 4.1 /5
- Open reqs (serving-runtime + infra): 12 -> 6 (closed 6)

Goals for next quarter (Q2-2026):
- Goal 1: Reduce time-to-productive (first 30 days) by 15% via onboarding improvements and manager checklist adoption.
  - Success metric: median 'time to first PR/first customer-facing task' down from 21d -> <=18d.
  - Projects: finalize playbook, roll out to Dedicated + Private teams, set adoption metric in ORBIT.
- Goal 2: Create a lightweight calibration 1-pager and run calibration dry-run with Eng managers before official cycle.
  - Success metric: >80% manager confidence score in post-dry-run survey.
- Goal 3: Improve hiring funnel quality for infra roles by adding two vetted sourcing partners and standardizing tech screen rubric.
  - Success metric: screen->onsite conversion up 10%.

Blockers / risks:
- Compensation bands from Finance delayed (blocks offers for L4+). Need escalation path - ask manager to nudge Finance lead.
- Interviewer availability remains tight in peak sprints. Proposal: designate 2 interview days per sprint for Eng teams (pilot). Need alignment from Eng leads.
- Headcount reprioritization rumor: product org may shift 3 hires to Q3. Need confirmation to plan backlog.

Manager ask / discussion points for 1:1:
- Quick sync: can you escalate comp band doc to Olivia in Finance? It's blocking 3 live offers.
- Approval: pilot 'designated interview days' for Eng teams - need leadership buy-in and brief comms.
- Budget: ask for $6k for external sourcing partner trial (2 months) to improve infra pipeline.
- Feedback needed: how should I prioritize manager enablement vs onboarding playbook this quarter? I think onboarding + hiring stabilization has stronger ROI but want your call.
- Calibration: can we schedule a 90-min dry-run with you + 6 Eng managers the week before calibration?

Notes to self / talking points (raw):
- Emphasize wins: 6 hires closed; TTO reduction; onboarding pilot feedback improved NPS. Keep it concise.
- Acknowledge where I need support: comp bands & interview capacity.
- Offer mitigation: propose contract extension for critical ICs while perm hiring continues.

Follow-ups / TODOs after 1:1:
- If manager okays, draft pilot comms for interview days (owner: me).
- Schedule comp band escalation with Olivia + FinOps (owner: manager + me).
- Finalize onboarding playbook v0.2 and publish Confluence link; collect adoption metrics.
- Book calibration dry-run and send prep notes to managers.

Random scratchpad / phrases to possibly include in summary email:
- "Closed 6/5 target hires; TTO down 28d; pilot onboarding shows +0.9 NPS"
- "Requesting $6k for sourcing pilot to improve infra funnel - projected ROI: 2 hires with <30d TTO"

Evidence / supporting docs to attach if asked:
- CONFLUENCE-OPS-4532 (onboarding playbook draft)
- JIRA-HIRE-1124 (hiring pipeline board + templates)
- Slack thread: #people-ops 'onboarding-pilot-feedback' (May)

Final note: keep doc short for manager; move detailed metrics into the Confluence appendix. Mark this as draft - will tidy and send 24h before 1:1."
